page: Hetzner Cloud cpx41 is an x86_64 virtual server powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at 2.0 GHz. It features 8 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with a shared CPU allocation model. The system is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 1.95 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled and consists of a 240 GB NVMe SSD, while the hypervisor layer is managed via QEMU. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included in this configuration.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the cpx41 delivers average multi-core performance but exhibits weak single-core capabilities. In stress-ng testing, single-core CPU performance falls into the bottom 10%, whereas multi-core performance reaches the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests, including both cached small-block reads and uncached large-block reads or writes, consistently rank in the average tier. Similarly, Geekbench multi-core, software compilation, and ray tracing benchmarks place the server in the middle 50% performance bracket, though single-threaded gzip compression and text processing show weaker results.

From a resource density perspective, the cpx41 offers a compute-leaning hardware profile with a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Because it utilizes a shared CPU allocation model, users may experience performance variability depending on host node neighbors, which represents a tradeoff against dedicated-core instances. However, the inclusion of 240 GB of local NVMe SSD storage alongside 8 vCPUs provides a cost-efficient profile for multi-threaded workloads that do not require sustained, isolated CPU performance.

This server configuration is suitable for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, and basic database operations, as reflected in its average Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput benchmarks. It is also capable of handling light software compilation and small-scale LLM inference tasks. It is less suited for single-threaded, CPU-bound tasks or memory-intensive applications that demand a higher RAM-to-vCPU ratio.
